definition: Correlation between pairwise distances in hidden-state space and readback-center space.
aggregation_unit: model x layer x projection condition x repeat
normalization: hidden and readback centers are compared through cosine-distance vectors
missing_value_rule: NaN if fewer than three valid pairs or near-zero variance
notes: Figure source uses preservation score summary.

definition: Decision-window dominance coordinate derived from clean-relative readback-margin trajectories.
formula: R_l = logit_l(clean_label) - logit_l(conflict_label); dR_l = R_l(condition) - R_l(clean_anchor); DeltaU = PC1(dR over decision_layers); sign flipped if mean(stable) < mean(closure)
normalization: PCA on clean-relative dR decision-layer matrix
missing_value_rule: standard PCA behaviour; source scripts raise if clean/conflict labels are not single tokens
notes: Decision layers use DECISION_FRAC=(0.70,0.92) in CM-5A/5B; CM-5B constrains predictors to predecision O_adv transitions.

definition: Layerwise advantage-flow proxy used to predict later Delta U and classify mechanism.
formula: O_adv_l = dR_{l+1} - dR_l; O-window features evaluated by GroupKFold graph splits with Ridge(alpha=10.0) for Delta U and balanced LogisticRegression for mechanism
valid_range: Delta U correlation in [-1,1]; F1 in [0,1]
notes: This is an observable proxy for path-advantage growth, not the final PhaseMap continuous operator coordinate.

definition: Gemma predecision TopK/VIM neighborhood transition features predicting later Delta U and mechanism under non-R readback-flow windows.
formula: R_l and DeltaU target as above; predictors are non-R neighborhood transition features summarized over leakage-free predecision windows; displayed metrics are ridge_deltaU_corr and mechanism_macro_f1
normalization: best k/window summaries exported by CM-5C
valid_range: Delta U correlation in [-1,1]; F1 in [0,1]
notes: CM-5C explicitly uses predecision TopK/VIM neighborhood transition features, not dR differences, to predict later decision-window Delta U.

definition: Auxiliary band-control check for phase classification under a global Delta U band.
formula: U_minus=(u_neg+u_crit)/2; U_plus=(u_crit+u_pos)/2; phase_pred_band assigns above, inside or below global band; displayed metrics are accuracy_score and f1_score(average=macro)
notes: Auxiliary support only; not treated as the primary ontology.

definition: Macro-averaged coefficient of determination for one-step next-layer state-equation closure variants.
formula: r2_score(y_true, y_pred, multioutput=uniform_average), with targets R_l1, boundary_dist_l1, spread_l1 and rank_gap_l1
aggregation_unit: model specification across 5-fold GroupKFold by graph_id
normalization: numeric features median-imputed and standardized; categorical features most-frequent-imputed and one-hot encoded; Ridge(alpha=10.0)
missing_value_rule: standard sklearn r2_score behaviour; failed models recorded as failed rows
notes: O_cont is op_pc1-op_pc10, a latent transition/operator coordinate; it is not claimed as a pure pre-transition observable.

definition: Relative alignment, detour and curvature behaviour of real trajectories compared with shuffle controls.
formula: Alignment gain = bias_real_align_mean - bias_shuffle_align_mean; Detour reduction = log2(bias_shuffle_detour_mean / bias_real_detour_mean); Curvature reduction = log2(bias_shuffle_curvature_mean / bias_real_curvature_mean)
normalization: positive values favour real trajectories relative to shuffle controls
valid_range: unbounded; sign is interpretable around zero
missing_value_rule: NaN if required mean is missing; log2 ratio undefined if denominator or numerator is non-positive
notes: GV-1B tests geodesic-biased flow with meaningful residuals, not strict geodesic equality.

definition: Correlation between projection, residual or mixed feature sets and Delta U.
formula: Projection = best_projection_deltaU_corr; Residual = best_resid_deltaU_corr; Mixed = best_mixed_deltaU_corr from GV-2 best-window summaries
normalization: best-window summary selected upstream in GV-2
missing_value_rule: standard correlation behaviour from GV-2 summary
notes: GV-2 compares residual_only, projection_only and mixed_projection_residual feature groups.

definition: Correlation between parallel, perpendicular or combined residual component proxies and Delta U.
formula: Parallel = best_parallel_deltaU_corr; Perpendicular = best_perp_deltaU_corr; Both = best_both_deltaU_corr from GV-3 sample_parallel_perp_eval summaries
normalization: best-window summary selected upstream in GV-3
missing_value_rule: standard correlation behaviour from GV-3 summary
notes: GV-3 uses proxy feature families; parallel/perpendicular labels are not literal full-manifold orthogonal decomposition.

definition: Difference between mean absolute Delta U shift in closure-target rows and non-closure rows after a control/intervention.
formula: specificity = mean(abs(DeltaU - DeltaU_base) | mechanism=closure) - mean(abs(DeltaU - DeltaU_base) | mechanism!=closure)
normalization: none; pseudo-log display transform in figure only
valid_range: reported values can be positive or negative; positive indicates closure-specific modulation
missing_value_rule: NaN if target or non-target rows are absent; shuffle z uses std + 1e-8
notes: Shuffle validation reports mean, std, z, percentile, q95 and q95 exceedance.

definition: Training-set quality metrics for mechanism and policy RandomForest classifiers used in steering analysis.
notes: Feature sets and hyperparameters are in classifier_spec_table_v0_2.csv.
